mapper.select: SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master ORDER BY review_start_date desc
SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}
SELECT eval_seq, company_code, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight FROM tb_eval_item WHERE review_master_code = #{rmCode}

SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master
AND review_master_name LIKE '%' || #{reviewMasterName} || '%'
AND review_start_date BETWEEN TRUNC(#{reviewStartDate}) AND TRUNC(#{reviewEndDate})
AND use_yn IN
#{yn}
ORDER BY review_start_date desc
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_make_date_code('REVIEW_MASTER') FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_hr_review_master ( company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{reviewMasterCode}, #{reviewMasterName}, #{reviewStartDate}, #{reviewEndDate}, #{useYn}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)

SELECT eval_seq.nextval FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_eval_item ( eval_seq, company_code, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{evalSeq}, #{companyCode}, #{reviewMasterCode}, #{evalName}, #{evalDetail}, #{evalWeight}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_review_master SET review_master_name = #{reviewMasterName}, review_start_date = #{reviewStartDate}, review_end_date = #{reviewEndDate}, use_yn = #{useYn}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = #{updateDate} WHERE review_master_code = #{reviewMasterCode}
mapper.select: SELECT company_code, review_master_code, review_master_name, review_start_date, review_end_date, use_yn, remark FROM tb_hr_review_master WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT eval_seq, review_master_code, eval_name, eval_detail, eval_weight FROM tb_eval_item ei WHERE review_master_code = #{reviewMasterCode}

SELECT m.company_code, m.review_master_code, m.review_master_name, m.review_start_date, m.review_end_date, NVL(COUNT(r.review_code), 0) AS total_review_cnt, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_cnt FROM tb_hr_review_master m LEFT JOIN tb_hr_review r ON r.company_code = m.company_code AND r.review_master_code = m.review_master_code AND r.rater_user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.company_code = #{companyCode} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY m.company_code, m.review_master_code, m.review_master_name, m.review_start_date, m.review_end_date ORDER BY m.review_start_date DESC

SELECT staff.user_id AS target_user_id, staff.user_name AS target_user_name, staff.dept AS target_dept, deptM.dept_name AS target_dept_name, staff.job_title AS target_job_title, --cm.code_name AS target_job_title_name, FN_FIND_CODENAME('0C', staff.job_title) AS target_job_title_name,
r.review_code, r.review_status, r.final_score, r.review_comment
FROM tb_user_master manager JOIN tb_user_master staff ON staff.company_code = manager.company_code AND staff.dept = manager.dept AND staff.user_id <> manager.user_id AND staff.user_status = '0'
LEFT JOIN tb_hr_review r ON r.company_code = staff.company_code AND r.review_master_code = #{reviewMasterCode} AND r.rater_user_id = manager.user_id AND r.target_user_id = staff.user_id
-- JOIN tb_cm_code cm -- ON staff.job_title = cm.code
JOIN tb_dept_master deptM ON staff.dept = deptM.dept_code
WHERE manager.company_code = #{companyCode} AND manager.user_id = #{raterUserId}
ORDER BY staff.user_name
mapper.insert:
SELECT fn_make_date_code('REVIEW') FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_hr_review ( review_code, rater_user_id, target_user_id, review_status, final_score, review_comment, created_by, create_date, company_code, review_master_code) VALUES ( #{reviewCode}, #{raterUserId}, #{targetUserId}, #{reviewStatus}, #{finalScore}, #{reviewComment}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{companyCode}, #{reviewMasterCode} )

SELECT review_result_seq.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO tb_hr_review_result ( review_result_seq, review_code, eval_seq, eval_item_score, created_by, create_date) VALUES ( #{reviewResultSeq}, #{reviewCode}, #{evalSeq}, #{evalItemScore}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT review_code, rater_user_id, target_user_id, review_status, final_score, review_comment, company_code, review_master_code FROM tb_hr_review WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND review_code = #{reviewCode}
SELECT review_result_seq, review_code, eval_seq, eval_item_score FROM tb_hr_review_result WHERE review_code = #{reviewCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_hr_review SET final_score = #{finalScore}, review_comment = #{reviewComment}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND review_code = #{reviewCode}
UPDATE tb_hr_review_result SET eval_item_score = #{evalItemScore}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_date = SYSDATE WHERE review_code = #{reviewCode} AND eval_seq = #{evalSeq}
